items.html: Therefore the ten Sefirot of ZA are considered from Chokhma and below, which is called "beginning" (Reshit), as mentioned, and not from Keter. And also not from Chesed and below, but from Chokhma and below, for everything is considered as the body of ZA itself; and they are Chokhma, Bina, Daat, Chesed, Gevura, Tifferet, Netzach, Hod, Yesod. And understand this rule.
